Llama-3-70B uses grouped-query attention with 80 layers, 8 KV heads, and head dimension 128 (hidden 8192 / 64 query heads).

Per token, each layer stores K and V:
2 (K and V) × 8 KV heads × 128 head dim × 2 bytes (BF16) = 4,096 bytes per layer.

Across all 80 layers: 4,096 × 80 = 327,680 bytes per token (320 KiB).
